sites_met_ans_nms_csv.title: Meteorological from Nuolja Middle Station, North-Western Sweden
sites_met_ans_nms_csv.custodian: Abisko Scientific Research Station / Swedish Polar Research Secretariat

bounded_external_sources_consulted.document_title: Abisko Scientific Research Station (ANS) Infrastructure & Station Overview
bounded_external_sources_consulted.findings: ANS operates environmental and climate monitoring networks in Abisko and Mount Nuolja. No commercial wind turbine or wind-generation asset was established in the bounded local-repository and authoritative-source search.
bounded_external_sources_consulted.limitations: Confirms that no wind generation asset was established in the bounded search.

bounded_external_sources_consulted.document_title: SITES Nuolja Meteorological Station Metadata & Landing Page
bounded_external_sources_consulted.findings: AWS located at 702m a.s.l. measures air temp, humidity, shortwave radiation, soil temp, precipitation, snow depth. Wind power generation is not measured.
bounded_external_sources_consulted.limitations: Dataset contains no wind speed or turbine generation fields.

missing_evidence_summary: Authoritative wind turbine asset identity for Nuolja (no commercial wind turbine asset was established in the bounded search).
Turbine manufacturer, model, rated electrical capacity, rotor diameter, and hub height.
Authoritative turbine power curve P(v) or empirical wind-to-power relationship.
Measured wind power generation telemetry (P_actual in W or kW).
Vertical wind profile shear exponent alpha or surface roughness z_0 for Mount Nuolja terrain.
minimum_next_prerequisites: Governance specification and authorization of a synthetic benchmark reference turbine (e.g., IEC class small wind turbine or micro-turbine spec) for POLARIS simulation purposes.
Formulation of a turbine power curve P(v) model operating on authorized reference turbine specifications.
Decision on whether to add wind_speed (m/s) representation to ForecastBundle or enforce P(v) conversion.
